text:
Ava (People Ops): Heads-up — a courier is dropping off a large terrarium + a box marked 'demo cake' at 3:30pm for the client walkthrough. Front desk badge printer is jittery today (keeps showing ERR 0x43). Can someone cover check-in and temp badges? Also we need a small table by the window and two couch seats reserved. cc @Ravi @FrontDeskBot

Ravi (Front Desk): On it. I can be there at 3:15 to meet them. If the printer dies I'll hand-write temp badges but prefer not to. Is the cake fragile? :cake:

Maya: I can grab the two couch seats signage and set up the table. Where should we stash the fragile box if needed? Lobby locker A is free.

Noah: I can stand by for badge printing if you need help troubleshooting. Printer log shows: `ERR 0x43 — paper feed jam?` Last reboot didn't clear it. If it won't print, use the spare label sheets in the supply closet and the handheld laminator (slot 2).

Lucas: I left a sticky note on the printer earlier about low ribbon. Might be that. Quick fix: swap ribbon with spare in the cabinet, then run `printer-test --labels 5`.

FrontDeskBot: Ticket #4521 created for printer error (priority: medium). Expected SLA 2h. Assigned to: Ravi.

Ava (People Ops): Thanks team. Maya — yep put fragile stuff in Lobby locker A and mark 'FRAGILE — DO NOT STACK'. Noah — if you end up doing hand-written badges, please stamp with the red ink so they look official. :thumbsup:

Ravi (Front Desk): Copy that. If printer still fails I'll do handwritten + laminate. Courier ETA confirmed 15:34 on the dock camera.

Maya: Table set & couch signs up. Left a tiny note for AV to bring the serving knife (weird, I know). :knife:

Noah: If someone wants to grab the cake box from the courier, I'll handle badges. Otherwise I'll wait at the desk.

Ava (People Ops): Noah take badges. Maya grab the cake. Ravi if ribbon swap works great, otherwise follow the laminate fallback. I'll ping facilities about an extra dolly for the terrarium. Thanks all! :seedling: :cake:

Ravi (Front Desk): Ribbon swap fixed it — printing 6 temp badges now. Marking ticket #4521 resolved. :tada:

FrontDeskBot: Ticket #4521 status updated: resolved by Ravi at 15:28.

Maya: Cake secured. Terrarium is huge but on dolly. Lobby locker A filled and labeled. All set.

Lucas: Nice teamwork — coffee for the front desk later? Who's in? :coffee:

Ava (People Ops): Count me in. I'll drop a box of pastries at 4pm. Thanks everyone!
